newsitem.title: USA: Conrail shuffles team to focus on merger.
newsitem.headline: Conrail shuffles team to focus on merger.

text.p: Conrail Inc on Thursday said it re-assigned two executives to focus on its proposed merger with CSX Corp.
Bruce Wilson, currently senior vice president for law and government affairs, will become senior vice president for mergers, effective February 1.
George Turner, who is now senior vice president for automotive services, was named senior vice president for merger consolidation.
Conrail and CSX said Wednesday they would be willing to meet with Norfolk Southern Corp, which has been seeking to derail the merger and buy Conrail itself.
CSX said earlier Thursday that it was optimistic about the possibility of a meeting with Norfolk Southern. But both Conrail and CSX said they remained "fully committed" to the merger.
